notes: Pre-trained baseline models. AIY Food V1 for binary gate + classify (no custom training). YOLO26n COCO FP16 for detection. NMS is performed in JavaScript, not baked into models.

models.name: AIY Food V1 (Binary Gate)
models.description: Google AIY Food V1 model repurposed as binary gate. Max confidence across 2024 food classes > threshold = food detected.

models.name: YOLO26n COCO Detection
models.description: YOLO26n pre-trained on COCO. 80 classes including 10 food items. NMS performed in JavaScript.

models.name: AIY Food V1 (Classification)
models.description: Google AIY Food V1 model for 2024-class food classification.
